categories.name: Low%
categories.rules:
As an Olmec speedrun, but Low% restricts the Spelunker in the following ways: 1) Increasing Health, Bombs, or Ropes, except from stolen Rope Piles recovered from Monkeys. 2) Collecting any Item that adds an icon to the HUD. 3) Wearing any Item. 4) Pressing the action/whip button while holding any Item listed in the Journal, except to drop it. This restriction does not apply to the Golden Idol, Monsters, or Traps. 5) Picking up the Shield.

Full list of submissions: https://mossranking.com/cat.php?cat=4

categories.name: All Shortcuts + Olmec
categories.rules:
The player has to start from the tutorial and unlock all the Tunnel Man shortcuts as well as defeat Olmec. The timer begins with the choice of player character and stops when the screen fades to black after the player leaves through the exit from Olmec's Lair.

Full list of submissions: https://mossranking.com/cat.php?cat=12

categories.name: All Journal Entries
categories.rules:
The player must unlocks all journal entries from a brand new save file. The timer begins with the choice of player character and stops once all journal entries are unlocked. No matter which timing mechanism is used (autosplitter that ends the timer automatically or with a manual timer), the player has to show all pages from the journal (Places, Monsters, Items, Traps), confirming that they are all unlocked.

Full list of submissions: https://mossranking.com/cat.php?cat=18

categories.name: Chain Low% Hell
categories.rules:
A Chain Hell% run following Low% restrictions, with the following item requirements:

1. Collecting the Udjat Eye is forbidden.
2. Collecting the Ankh, Hedjet, and Book of the Dead is required.
3. The Scepter must be used to open the door to the City of Gold. Firing it is forbidden.
